No pom.xml found in this workspace.
[Refresh](command:wasTools.maven.refresh)
cfg.wasHome: WebSphere install root (contains `bin/` and `properties/profileRegistry.xml`). Empty = auto-detect.
cfg.profilePath: Profile folder (e.g. `C:\IBM\WebSphere\AppServer\profiles\AppSrv01`). Empty = default profile of `profileRegistry.xml`.
cfg.serverName: Application server name (e.g. `server1`, `WebSphere_Portal`). Empty = the profile's only server.
cfg.cell: Cell. Empty = from the profile configuration.
cfg.node: Node. Empty = from the profile configuration.
cfg.username: Administrator user (wsadmin, stopServer, XMLAccess). Empty when administrative security is off. **The password is not a setting**: use *WebSphere: Configure User and Password* (stored in the OS secret storage).
cfg.appUrl: URL opened by "Open Application". Empty = https://host:<WC_defaulthost_secure>/ (Portal: /wps/myportal/).
cfg.portal: Use WebSphere Portal features (XMLAccess backup) when the profile is a Portal profile.
cfg.stopTimeout: Minutes to wait for stopServer before killing the server process.
cfg.consoleEncoding: Encoding of the output of WAS command line tools. Empty = windows-1252 on Windows, utf-8 elsewhere.
cfg.ports.https: WC_defaulthost_secure (the server is "running" when it listens). 0 = from serverindex.xml.
cfg.ports.debug: JDWP debug port. 0 = from server.xml debugArgs (7777 if not set).
cfg.mvn: Maven executable. Empty = maven.executable.path, mvnw of the workspace, MAVEN_HOME or mvn on PATH.
cfg.javaHome: JDK used to run Maven (JAVA_HOME). Empty = the JDK bundled with WAS (`<wasHome>/java/<version>`), so the bytecode matches the server.
cfg.extraArgs: Extra arguments for every Maven run (e.g. "-s", "settings.xml", "-U").
cfg.goals: Goals offered by "Run Goals…". Empty = clean, compile, package, install, clean install, test…
cfg.apps: Applications installed in WAS that are published from this workspace. Filled by **WebSphere: Detect Installed Applications**; can be edited by hand.
cfg.app.name: Application name in WAS.
cfg.app.type: war: web root + WEB-INF/classes; ear: only modules (jars).
cfg.app.installed: Exploded install folder under installedApps (the .war folder inside the .ear, or the .ear).
cfg.app.web: war only: Maven project folder (relative to the workspace) with the web root and target/classes.
cfg.app.webRoot: Web root inside webProject. Empty = WebContent or src/main/webapp.
cfg.app.libs: Shared libraries the application must reference.
cfg.app.modules: Jars built from workspace projects and copied into the application.
cfg.mod.project: Maven project folder (relative to the workspace, or absolute).
cfg.mod.target: Path of the jar inside the installed application (e.g. WEB-INF/lib/core-1.0.jar, lib/core.jar, MyEJB.jar).
cfg.onSave: Copy web resources (xhtml, js, css, images…) to the installed application on save.
cfg.maxClass: Highest class file version allowed when publishing (52 = Java 8, 55 = 11, 61 = 17). 0 = from the server JDK.
cfg.backupDir: Folder for backups (overwritten files, configuration copies, trust store). Empty = extension storage.
cfg.ignore: Regular expressions of log lines to hide (noise).
